messages.author: 309020ec5c5877c4
messages.subject: standard errors for correlation matrix
parts:
I am using lavInspect to report the correlation matrix of the latent variables. I wonder is there a way to have the standard errors and p-value reported in the correlation matrix of latent variables? Thank you. Below is the syntax:

CFAmodel <- '
SS =~ Q42 + Q46 +Q48
CS =~ Q20 + Q26 
JS =~ Q69 + Q71
SEX=~DSEX
Q99=~Q9'

TR5fac.fit <-cfa(CFAmodel,data=data1,estimator="DWLS",std.lv=T)
summary(TR5fac.fit,fit.measures=T,standardized=T)

lavInspect(TR5fac.fit,"cor.lv")

messages.author: 12fdd832cacb825e
messages.subject: Re: standard errors for correlation matrix
parts:
I don't think so, but unsolicited advice: Draw conclusions from SEs and p-values of unstandardized coefficients--in this case, covariances, not correlations. SEs on correlations aren't useful anyway, since the correlation coefficient has an asymmetric sampling distribution (a Q distribution, I think? but definitely skewed). The sampling distribution of the covariance isn't normal, either, but isn't usually going to be as bad since it doesn't have a ceiling, but there are still better ways to test it than z-tests.

Pat
